title: Employees
description: Employee records and their sign-in accounts, within your permissions.
formIntro: Fill in the six sections. On save, a sign-in account is created and the employee receives an invitation to link the authenticator app.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, number or email
emptyHint: Start by adding the first employee. Build the company structure (levels, units and job titles) first.

hints.hrOnly: Changed by HR or the platform administrator.
hints.managerDefault: The unit's manager is proposed for a new employee; you can change it or clear it. A direct manager is not required.
hints.workEmail: It is the sign-in email and the Microsoft account, and cannot be changed later.
hints.emailLocked: The work email is the sign-in identity and cannot be changed.
hints.idNumber: Checked by ID type (and nationality for some types).
hints.currency: The work country's currency is proposed.
hints.iban: Saudi IBAN: SA followed by 22 digits.
hints.terminationReason: Shown once an end date is set.
hints.roles: Optional. Roles can be changed later from the employee page.

validation.workEmail: The work email is not a valid address.
validation.personalEmail: Not a valid email, or the same as the work email.
validation.birthDate: Date of birth not accepted (age 18 to 70).
validation.idNumber: An ID number is required together with its type.
validation.idTypeId: An ID type is required together with its number.
validation.idExpiryDate: Must be after the date of birth.
validation.startDate: Invalid date, or before the employee turned 18.
validation.endDate: Must be after the start date.
validation.gosiRegistrationDate: Required, and not before the start date.
validation.monthlyGrossSalary: Enter a number that is zero or more.
validation.salaryCurrencyCountryId: Choose the currency when a salary is entered.

flags.accessEnded: Sign-in ended with the contract on {{date}}

deactivated: Account deactivated and its sessions ended.
resetDone: The app was reset and a new invitation was sent.

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate the account?
deactivateDialog.description: The employee can no longer sign in and their sessions end at once. You can activate it again later.

resetDialog.title: Reset the authenticator app?
resetDialog.description: The employee's sessions end now, and a new invitation reaches them to link the app on their phone.

terminate.title: End of contract
terminate.description: Record the end date and the reason. Sign-in stops the day after the end date.

rolesDialog.title: Employee roles
rolesDialog.description: Choose the roles. You cannot grant permissions wider than your own.

invitation.sent: An activation invitation was sent to {{email}}.
invitation.failed: The employee was saved but the email could not be sent. Use “Resend invitation”.

import.notFound: No employee has the number “{{value}}” within your reach.
import.titleWithUnit: Give the job title together with the new unit so it fits.
import.nothingToChange: No value in this row changes anything.
import.updateDescription: A row is identified by the employee number, and the cells you fill are what changes; an empty cell leaves the record as it is. A change of unit, job title or manager takes effect today and is kept in the history.

groupsDialog.title: Groups of roles
groupsDialog.description: Each group gives the employee every role inside it.

employees.title: Employees
employees.body: The directory of employees and their records: name, unit, title, status and work details. Search and filter by company, unit, status and more, and open any record for its details. What you see follows your permissions and scope.

can.create: Add a new employee and send them an activation link
can.update: Edit employees’ details and move them between units
can.deactivate: Deactivate an account or end an employee’s service
can.sensitive: See national ID, IBAN and salary
can.impersonate: Sign in as an employee to see what they see (when it is switched on in the security settings)

employee-history.title: Employee history
employee-history.body: Open any employee and then the «History» tab: their unit, job title and manager through time (what is in force and what waits for its day), and what was done to their record, by whom and when.

employee-photo.title: Profile photo
employee-photo.body: On an employee's page add or change a photo: choose the picture, then move the square over the face. It shows in the directory and the employee list.

bulk-update.title: Bulk edit
bulk-update.body: Select several employees in the list and press «Bulk edit»: choose what changes (unit, job title, manager, work location…), and preview who would change and who would be refused, and why, before applying.

directory.title: My team
directory.body: The «My team» tab shows your colleagues in your unit: name, photo, job title, work e-mail and phone. Search, narrow by company and job title, and open a colleague to see their profile. It shows more if you are their manager.

can.export: Export your team to a file

rolesStep.titleMissing: Choose the job title in the first step and its role appears here.
rolesStep.extraHint: Optional. The head roles of the employee's company, the manual roles and what the person already holds; only roles you can give are listed. A last day can be set for each role.
rolesStep.defaultsHint: The Employee role and the role of the job title chosen in the first step are ticked from the start. You can untick either.
rolesStep.everyoneOff: Without the Employee role the employee will not see their personal pages (my account, security, notifications, tickets).

placement.title: Unit, job title and manager through time
placement.hint: Each change closes the previous value the day before it starts. A later change waits for its day and then takes effect by itself.
placement.empty: No history yet: it starts with the first change.

changes.title: Log of changes to the record

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the waiting change?
cancelDialog.description: The previous value stays in force and this change is not applied.

placementChange.effectiveFromHint: Today or a later date; a later change waits for its day.
placementChange.reasonRequired: Write the reason for changing the unit, title or manager.

photo.title: Employee photo
photo.description: Choose a JPEG or PNG, then move the square over the face and save.
photo.drop: Drop the picture here, or click to browse
photo.hint: JPEG or PNG; it is cropped square and shrunk before upload (limit 2 MB).
photo.unreadable: The picture could not be read.

removeDialog.title: Remove the photo?
removeDialog.description: The first letter of the name is shown instead.

bulk.title: Bulk edit of {{count}} employees
bulk.description: Choose the values to change (what you leave empty stays as it is), then preview who would change and who would be refused before applying.
bulk.companyHint: Decides which units are offered; anyone in another company is refused with the reason.
bulk.titleHint: Choose it together with the unit so it fits.
bulk.someRefused: {{count}} employees were refused; see the preview.
bulk.tooMany: You cannot select more than {{max}} employees in one edit.

team.title: My team
team.description: Your colleagues in your unit: name, job title and how to reach them at work.
team.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, e-mail or phone
team.name: Name
team.empty: No other colleagues in your unit.
team.noUnitHint: Your team shows once you are placed in a unit.
